mentions.name: OpenTTD 12.2 C rewrite
mentions.description: A rewrite of OpenTTD version 12.2 that strips out the C++ and reorganizes the game back into C code, simplifying the codebase as groundwork before adding features. It converts the game to more realistic time pacing and adds scheduling features and more event-based gameplay.
mentions.problem: OpenTTD's game time is unrealistically fast, and the codebase had reached a complicated breaking point.
mentions.source_excerpt: Pulling apart and de-++-ing OpenTTD version 12.2 to scratch my itch of simplifying and reorganising the game back to C code. I rewrote it years ago to convert it to more realistic time (it's just way too fast), add scheduling features and make it more event based.
